name: boringstack-ui
description: Production-grade SPA starter (Vite + React + TypeScript) for the BoringStack family. Wired with shadcn/ui, TanStack Query, Zustand, react-router, RHF + Zod, i18next, Storybook, Playwright, and 8 custom ESLint plugins enforcing the architecture.

scripts.validate: bun run check && bun run test:ci && bun run build && bun run size:check && bun run size:check:modulepreload
scripts.validate:full: bun run validate && bun run e2e:ci
scripts.analyze: ANALYZE=true bun run build && open dist/stats.html
scripts.release: bun run validate && changeset tag && git push --follow-tags
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run lint:meta && bun run check:lint-meta-docs && bun run format:check && bun run typecheck && bun run knip

//overrides._: Why these transitive deps are pinned. Dev tooling only — lighthouse/lhci and http-server pull the vulnerable ranges; production output is a static bundle. Astro-only build deps (e.g. devalue, GHSA-77vg-94rm-hx3p) are pinned in apps/docs, not here — the Vite toolchain does not pull them.
//overrides.ws: Pin patched ws (GHSA-58qx-3vcg-4xpx) pulled via lighthouse dev tooling; mirrors the docs app pin.
//overrides.qs: Pin patched qs (GHSA-q8mj-m7cp-5q26) pulled via dev tooling; mirrors the docs app pin.
//overrides.tmp: Pin patched tmp (GHSA-7c78-jf6q-g5cm type-confusion path traversal); 0.2.6 is now vulnerable, 0.2.7 patches it. Transitive dev-tooling dep via @lhci/cli. Mirrors the docs app pin.
//overrides.undici: Pin patched undici (GHSA-vmh5-mc38-953g TLS cert-validation bypass, GHSA-pr7r-676h-xcf6); pulled in transitively by jsdom (test environment only). 7.28.0 is the patched release. Excluded from the install quarantine while <7 days old.
//overrides.@types/react: Single React types resolution across the workspace.
//overrides.@types/react-dom: Single React DOM types resolution across the workspace.
//overrides.@typescript-eslint/utils: Match the API app's pin so the shared ESLint plugins resolve one utils version.
//overrides.react: Single React runtime across the workspace. zustand declares react as an exact-pinned optional peer, so without this it keeps its own nested copy when the top-level react bumps — two React instances break hooks ("Cannot read properties of null (reading 'useCallback')") in tests. Keep in lockstep with the react dependency.
//overrides.react-dom: Mirror the react pin so the renderer never drifts from React itself ("mismatching versions of React and the renderer").
